description_en: Queries traces by time, application name, IP address, span name, and tag
description_zh: 查询调用链列表信息，可根据时间、应用名称、IP地址、Span名称和Tag等信息筛选调用链
kebab_example: aliyun arms search-traces --start-time 1595174400000 --end-time 1595210400000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-name arms-k8s-demo-subcomponent --operation-name /demo/queryNotExistDB/11 --min-duration 2 --reverse false --service-ip 172.20.XX.XX --pid b590lhguqs@9781be0f44dXXXX --tag Value=200 Key=http.status_code --exclusion-filters Value=404 Key=http.status_code --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchTraces

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the traced span
parameters.name: operation_name

parameters.help_en: The minimum amount of time consumed by traces. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.name: min_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the query results in chronological order or reverse chronological order. Default value: `false`.

`true`: sorts the query results in reverse chronological order.
`false`: sorts the query results in chronological order
parameters.help_zh:
按照时间正序或者倒序排列。默认值为`false`。

`true`：表示倒序
`false`：表示正序
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the host where the application resides
parameters.name: service_ip

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key. The following system preset fields are provided:

serverApp: the name of the server application.
clientApp: the name of the client application.
service: the name of the operation.
rpc: the type of the call.
msOfSpan: the duration exceeds a specific value.
clientIp: the IP address of the client.
serverIp: the IP address of the server.
isError: specifies whether the call is abnormal.
hasTprof: contains only thread profiling
element_fields.help_zh:
Tag的主键。系统预置字段如下：

serverApp：服务端应用名
clientApp：客户端应用名
service：接口名称
rpc：调用类型
msOfSpan：耗时大于
clientIp：客户端IP
serverIp：服务端IP
isError：是否异常调用
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The key that is used to filter the query results
element_fields.help_zh: 用于排除的筛选条件的主键
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The value of the key that is used to filter the query results
element_fields.help_zh: 用于排除的筛选条件的值
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_zh: 用于排除的筛选条件结构体
parameters.name: exclusion_filters
